buildAuctionLeg((address,address,address.details: SIGNATURE mode (ERC-1271 by the escrow), NOT Aqua mode: Aqua fillers must push tokenIn into the strategy, which inflates the bid-side pricing balance and breaks the decay curve after the first partial fill. `_staticBalancesXD` re-seeds pricing from program bytes on every fill, so the price is purely time-decayed. Collateral custody stays capped by the escrow's bounded router allowance.

params.rateBps: annual simple-interest rate in basis points (e.g. 820 = 8.20%)

buildAquaLimitLeg(address,address,addres.notice: Generic two-token Aqua limit leg (balance-ratio priced, drifts with fills). Kept for the Test 1 round trip and as the base of the auction leg.

buildAuctionLeg((address,address,address.notice: Dutch-auction liquidation leg: unit price decays from startBidRef/collateral toward the floor (reached at expiry); `_stopWhenCovered` halts sales the moment `target` USDC is raised. Partial fills welcome — every SwapVM filler is a liquidator.

buildFacilityLeg((address,address,addres.notice: Facility open/draw leg: each draw is a zero-in exact-out partial fill of the committed pullToken; `_stopWhenCovered` caps cumulative draws at the facility size.

buildMaturityLeg((address,address,addres.notice: Maturity leg (per draw): zero-in pull of the repayment from the borrower's Aqua balance, gated by maturity time and the settlement executor. `_stopWhenCovered` doubles as double-settlement protection (a second pull hits OrderCovered).

repaymentAmount(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Zero-coupon repayment for a draw: principal × (1 + rateBps · term / 365d)
